If your Blundstone boots don’t work out, you have these options:

Return for a refund:

Free returns within 30 days of purchase/order.
Boots must be unworn, in original condition/packaging, ideally tried on indoors on carpet.
Start your return via our Returns Portal using your order number and email.
Refunds are issued to the original method of payment and typically process within 8 business days after we receive your return, plus up to 10 additional business days for your bank to post the credit.

Order a different pair:

We don’t offer exchanges, but you can return your original order for a refund and then place a new order for a different size or style at any time.

Multiple pairs in one order:

If several pairs were in one order, they can all be returned using one return label.
If they were from separate orders, you’ll need one label per order to avoid refund delays.
